rites.name: Maunor
rites.text: A raw discipline of wild, untamed fury that lets a fighter draw on unpredictable turmoil. It was devised for a single roaming warrior by an inventive storyteller.

rites.name: Vornines
rites.text: Vornines is the concept of resonance bound into the first roots of Corolor, a pull that holds newborn matter to its shape during the Singing. In the Age of Sundering it is said to have thinned where landfall broke old bonds, leaving the world's seams audible to those who listen.

rites.name: Iseivsora
rites.text: Iseivsora is the concept of resonance that threads through Corolor during the Singing, when the first roots of the world condensed out of pure sound. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall split the old bonds between lands, Iseivsora was the note that held the broken pieces in tune.

rites.name: Silarlaemys
rites.text: Silarlaemys is the concept of resonance that binds the first roots of Corolor during the Singing, a sounding that predates any dated Record. In the Age of Strangers, visiting traders learned to hum their own notes into its chord so that their anchors would hold.

rites.name: Conor
rites.text: Conor is a concept of Corolor, the idea of a crown that is given by a council rather than taken by force, and it appears in the Courts during the age of divine trials. It is said to have shaped the first doors between worlds, which the groves and growing kingdoms of that era depended upon to pass between their lands.

rites.name: Thouktak
rites.text: Thouktak is the concept of the Corolor Courts, the judging principle that weighs oaths before the divine councils during the Age of Sundering. It is named for the moment a trial turns from words to the raising of a door between worlds.

rites.name: Oreornus
rites.text: A sacred discipline for priests that channels the power of the two silver sisters orbiting the sky. Its devotees draw strength from the pale night lights to guide their magic.

rites.name: Veostiarnia
rites.text: A chilling incantation of the arcane arts, cast by a wind-tempered mage of the old orders. It is a fourth-tier working that unleashes a surge of freezing force.

rites.name: Seosium
rites.text: A binding incantation that lets its caster move across open water unhindered. It is recorded as a conjured working drawn from older campaign lore.

rites.name: Naullor
rites.text: A craft in which practitioners draw upon a living person's blood to inflict injury, mend wounds, or shift the vital force that flows within others.

rites.name: Coralanum
rites.text: A protective ward woven from air that shields a bearer against being bound or held by others. It is recorded as a spell of warding.

rites.name: Ceolus
rites.text: A sealing working that strips away all enchantments within a broad region and can unmake the charms bound into enchanted objects. It leaves the surrounding world quiet and inert.

rites.name: Amilaurnum
rites.text: A fierce warrior discipline for wild fighters who hold their ground and push enemies into disadvantaged positions. While enraged, they turn any battlefield into their own, hurling foes off cliffs and smashing sturdy fortifications.

rites.name: Oriallium
rites.text: A charm that carries restorative magic. It is said to bring a wound back together.

rites.name: Siantum
rites.text: A chill sickness deliberately crafted by sorcerers to weaken holy powers, which can only be cured by one particular remedy.

rites.name: Nanus Vaulintanum
rites.text: A sealed enchantment of transmutation that a mage devised to lock away objects in a sheath of golden resin. It belongs to the arcane practice of changing matter.

rites.name: Valeonastor
rites.text: A minor incantation that releases a crackling bolt of storm energy outward from the caster, striking everything nearby. It is the simplest working taught to apprentices of the arcane arts.

rites.name: Rinum
rites.text: A fourth-tier evocation craft cast by a wandering scholar of fire. Its practitioners weave threads of flame into a binding lattice that answers to the caster's will.

rites.name: Velles
rites.text: A binding incantation of sound-magic that a single scholar devised long ago. It lets the caster repeat the force of a spoken word after it has faded.

rites.name: Vaullarnes
rites.text: A ritual craft that draws a fallen traveler back from the threshold of death. Companions often attempt it together when the rite is within reach.

rites.name: Taleostium
rites.text: A grave-binding rite raises a bone-built servant shaped like a winged beast, which obeys commands but cannot share the caster's senses. Only one such servant can persist at a time.

rites.name: Rosellus
rites.text: A third-tier invocation that lets a practitioner pass short messages to a distant creature. The words travel across vast distances to reach their intended recipient.

rites.name: Calia
rites.text: A ritual binding that calls forth a crimson-hued spirit bound to serve its caster's will as a loyal companion in battle.

rites.name: Valirnum
rites.text: A temple-trained working that conjures a churning tempest over a chosen zone, striking everything caught within with crackling bolts and crushing gusts.

rites.name: Ciastor Valirnenia
rites.text: A sacred ceremony used by priests to cast a divine being out of the mortal world. It drives a deity back beyond the reach of the living realm.

rites.name: Valestanum
rites.text: A sacred working that ties the spirit of a divine being to the mortal world and its endless cycle of rebirth. The bound spirit slowly regains its memory and some of its strength, while remaining hidden from those who hunt gods.

rites.name: Sileiluarys
rites.text: Sileiluarys is the concept of the Weave as the makers plant it, a quiet pattern of latent power that lies dormant until the Sundering wakes it. It is less a force than a promise, a pressure held in reserve beneath the surface of the world.

rites.name: Sianteostum
rites.text: A ritual craft that splits the ground into a square of crimson tempest, striking everything within with shocks. Those caught fail to dodge are bound by thin, violet-red tendrils of hardened lightning.

rites.name: Selor
rites.text: A class of summoners who trick wicked otherworldly beings into doing good deeds, though they are not wicked themselves. Their zeal sometimes leads them to call on forces they do not fully grasp, at great risk to their own lives.

rites.name: Amonum
rites.text: A taught incantation of the bending-fate art that a learner can later master. Once mastered, the caster may invoke it freely, without spending a reserved charge of magic.

rites.name: Canisanum
rites.text: A mysterious supernatural force that flows through the world and takes many forms, such as incantations, elaborate rites, charged relics, and baleful hexes. Those who wield it may gain it through a sudden awakening or be born able to channel it.

rites.name: Valosia
rites.text: A borrowed dark power, shaped by a crafter's hand, that one wielder draws upon from a fragment of shadow. It belongs to a single bearer within a long-running tale.

rites.name: Kaiktozhun
rites.text: Kaiktozhun is the concept of the Fall in Corolor, the principle by which a bound world tears apart and its pieces scatter into the void. Its presence during the Sundering was felt as a slow pressure that cracked the old orders and gave birth to the Shards that the Pact later sought to gather.

rites.name: Veliastia
rites.text: Two companions fight side by side, lifting and shielding each other in battle. One gently eases the other's lingering pain through careful, asked-for touch, and the other trusts this care above all.

rites.name: Contenus
rites.text: A dreamweaving rite lets a caster slip into another sleeper's dreams alongside companions. The sleeper's mind can still pull the intruders into strange and dangerous currents.

rites.name: Vernium Niallosus
rites.text: A high-level shaping charm that rewrites the form of a living thing. Three scholars pooled their craft and borrowed ancient notes from a hidden archive to perfect it.

rites.name: Valisium Telestanum
rites.text: Two allied companions share the ability to sense what others are thinking. They have worked together on probing another person's recollections and refused to abandon each other when trapped inside a mind.

rites.name: Amianoranum
rites.text: A forbidden working lets a mortal climb into divinity. Few have ever completed it, and each who did reshaped the realm in their own way.
